programs.title: The Munsters
programs.desc: Transylvania.Dr. Henry Augustus Wolfgang (Richard Brake) and his not very bright assistant Floop (Jorge Garcia) want to create the perfect man from the dead bodies of geniuses of the past century.By mistake, instead of the brain of a great scientist, they implant the organ of his twin brother, a bad comedian, into the creature they created.This is how Herman Potwornicki (Jeff Daniel Phillips) is created.When Wolfgang decides to show it to the world on TV, he is devastated.However, the uncouth, joking giant attracts the attention of the unmarried and undead Lily (Sheri Moon), who is fed up with unsuccessful dates.The girl finds Herman and they quickly become a couple.The future son-in-law, although he gained fame and won Lily's heart, does not like her father, a vampire and a refined count (Daniel Roebuck).However, the lovers get married.Due to the intrigues of the count's cunning ex-wife, Zoya Krupp (Catherine Schell) and her assistant, the werewolf Lester (Tomas Boykin), they lose their palace and fortune.They decide to go to America, where Herman intends to conquer Hollywood.They start a new life in a ruined house in the suburbs.A colorful production referring to the series from the 1960s. Director Rob Zombie is his big fan.

programs.title: The Hobbit: The Battle of the Five Armies
programs.desc: Thorin Oakenshield, the hobbit Bilbo and their companions recover the treasure of Erebor, which was guarded by Smaug.The leader of a company of dwarves cannot resist wealth.He sacrifices friendship and honor to gloat over him.To make matters worse, armies of elves and humans appear at the Lonely Mountain, intending to take over some of the dwarves' gold as compensation for the losses caused by the dragon.For years, the beast ravaged the area and destroyed their settlements.Proud Thorin does not intend to give in to the demands of the newcomers.To resolve conflicts, Bilbo secretly gives the elves the archjewel.They use the treasure as an argument in negotiations with Thorin, and the hobbit becomes a traitor to the dwarves.While representatives of different races are arguing with each other and trying to force concessions, the army of their common enemy is approaching the dwarves' headquarters.In the face of danger, the conflicting parties must unite.

programs.title: L'amica geniale 3
programs.desc: Lila (Gaia Gerace) decided to leave her husband and is currently raising little Rino alone.After leaving her comfortable life behind, she has to support herself and her child, so she works in difficult conditions in a meat processing plant.Elena (Margherita Mazzucco), who left the old Neapolitan district, is already studying in Pisa.The woman also manages to publish a successful novel, opening the door to the world of wealthy people for its author.Although Lila and Elena's relationship has loosened and they live as if in different worlds, they both struggle with many limitations.So they take advantage of the opportunities brought by the social changes of the 1970s. Adaptation of the 3rd volume of the best-selling novel series by Elena Ferrante.

programs.title: Little women
programs.desc: The times of the Civil War.In the absence of their father, who is serving in the military away from the family, the four March sisters from Orchard House are cared for by their mother alone.Marmee wants them to find their own path and helps them enter adulthood.Each of them has a different personality.The oldest Meg dreams of becoming an actress.Family-oriented and warm, Beth has a talent for playing the piano.Jo, an aspiring writer, pursues her goal with her characteristic energy and tenacity.Amy, a bit smart, wants to become a painter.Despite their own problems, the girls are not indifferent to other people's suffering.Young women will get to know the taste of first loves and disappointments.Fate subjects them to tests, after which their lives will never be the same again.

programs.title: Father
programs.desc: A Moldovan journalist discovers that her father, employed in Italy, is being exploited and beaten by his employer.As she investigates, she discovers that her father was also violent towards others.

programs.title: Red One
programs.desc: The third joint film of Jake Kasdan and Dwayne Johnson, after two installments of the new version of "Jumanji".The head of North Pole security and a bounty hunter search for the missing Santa Claus.

programs.title: Last Week Tonight With John Oliver 13
programs.desc: Another season of a show full of irony and sarcasm, hosted by John Oliver.In each episode, the host summarizes the events from the world of politics from the last week.

programs.title: Minecraft
programs.desc: Garrett (Jason Momoa), Henry (Sebastian Hansen), Natalie (Emma Myers) and Dawn (Danielle Brooks) constantly struggle with problems.The lives of these four change when a magical portal pulls them into a strange land full of cubes.The Overworld turns out to be a place where everything is possible thanks to imagination, which, however, is sometimes difficult to control.Once there, Garrett, Henry, Natalie and Dawn meet Steve (Jack Black), who was trapped on this side of the portal many years earlier.Together with him, they decide to defend the unusual land from evil creatures called piglins.For them to succeed, they will have to show courage and discover qualities that will make it easier for them to find their place in the real world later.A hit production for the whole family, inspired by the popular game.

programs.title: Insecure 4
programs.desc: Friends Issa Dee (Issa Rae) and Molly try to find their way in the world of Los Angeles.Shy Issa struggles with everyday problems and, despite her lack of self-confidence, tries to live on her own terms.

programs.title: The Last of Us 2
programs.desc:
Five years have passed since Ellie (Bella Ramsey) and Joel (Pedro Pascal)'s dangerous journey.They both still function in a world whose rules are dictated by a pandemic caused by cordyceps.At first it is easier for them because they live in the city of Jackson, where they have many friends.However, when the man is caught up in the revenge of Abby Anderson (Kaitlyn Dever), the daughter of a doctor from Salt Lake City, and the soldiers from her unit - the Wolves - Ellie has no choice but to leave the town to find her and retaliate.She is accompanied on a dangerous expedition by her friend, Dina (Isabela Moner).
The action flashes back to the year Ellie and Joel moved into Jackson.Their relationship at that time was very cordial, and every year on the occasion of his ward's birthday, the man came up with an interesting surprise for her.Relations between them began to deteriorate a few years later, when the girl realized that Joel had hidden the truth from her about the events at the hospital in Salt Lake City.In addition, soon, while on patrol together, the man once again lies about the circumstances of the death of Eugene, Gail's husband.This makes Ellie not want to talk to him.

programs.title: True Blood
programs.desc: The second part of the series about Sookie Stackhouse, who reads people's minds, and about a town where humans and vampires live side by side...
